hypotheses.justification: Global existence of limits is unnecessary. CategoryTheory.Presheaf.isSheaf_comp_of_isSheaf shows that every sheaf used here remains a sheaf after composing with forget C, using only the retained limit-preservation assumption. TopCat.Presheaf.IsSheaf.isSheafUniqueGluing_types then provides elementwise gluing and uniqueness. Use these to replace the concrete-category gluing/local-equality lemmas, also in the proof of the injectivity helper. The remaining filtered-colimit argument is unchanged. Empty covers are included in this gluing result, so empty U causes no exception. This hypothesis and the reflection hypothesis can even be removed together.

Only the forward transfer of the sheaf condition to underlying types is needed. CategoryTheory.Presheaf.isSheaf_comp_of_isSheaf requires limit preservation, not reflection of isomorphisms. Apply TopCat.Presheaf.IsSheaf.isSheafUniqueGluing_types to obtain gluing and local equality, replacing the corresponding concrete-category lemmas both here and in the injectivity helper. All other steps remain valid without reflection. The type-valued gluing theorem handles empty covers as well. This hypothesis and global limit existence can be removed together.
